description: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of two categories related to the performance or breakdown of a system, likely from the paper "Paper Copilot A Self-Evolving and Efficient LLM System for Personalized Academic Assistance". The chart is divided into two slices: the larger, orange slice labeled "Reduction" accounts for 69.92% of the total, while the smaller, blue slice labeled "Efficient deployment" accounts for 30.08%. The chart includes percentage labels directly within each slice and does not appear to have a separate legend. The slice for "Reduction" is visually emphasized by being slightly exploded or offset from the center, drawing attention to its dominant share. The two categories are presented in a descending order of size, with "Reduction" occupying the majority of the pie.
